scheme_name: Popularisation Of Fishery Machinery/ Equipments/ Implements” For Intensive Aquaculture In Odisha For The Financial Year 2021-22
description:
The scheme titled "Popularisation Of Fishery Machinery/ Equipments/ Implements For Intensive Aquaculture In Odisha" was launched by the Government of Odisha in the financial year 2021-22. 

This initiative is part of the broader strategy to enhance aquaculture practices in the state. 

The scheme aims to promote the use of modern fishery machinery and equipment. 

The objective is to increase fish production and productivity in Odisha. 

The government has set a target to boost fish production by 20 percent over the next five years. 

This initiative is crucial for improving the livelihoods of fish farmers in the region. 

The scheme focuses on providing financial assistance for the purchase of fishery machinery and equipment. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is up to 50 percent of the total cost of the machinery. 

The maximum limit for financial assistance is capped at ₹1 lakh per beneficiary. 

This means that if a beneficiary purchases equipment worth ₹2 lakh, they can receive ₹1 lakh as assistance. 

The scheme is designed to benefit small and marginal farmers primarily. 

Eligibility criteria for this scheme include being a resident of Odisha. 

Applicants must be engaged in aquaculture practices. 

The scheme is open to individuals as well as self-help groups. 

There is no specific age limit mentioned for eligibility. 

However, applicants must have a valid bank account to receive the financial assistance. 

The application process involves several steps. 

First, interested beneficiaries must visit the official website of the Fisheries and Animal Resources Development Department of Odisha. 

They need to download the application form available on the website. 

The completed application form must be submitted to the nearest Fisheries office. 

Along with the application form, applicants must provide certain documents. 

These documents include proof of identity such as an Aadhaar card. 

Applicants must also submit proof of residence. 

A bank account statement is required to verify the account details. 

Additionally, a project report detailing the intended use of the machinery must be included. 

Once the application is submitted, it will be scrutinized by the officials. 

If approved, the financial assistance will be disbursed directly to the beneficiary's bank account. 

The timeline for the application process is typically within a month from submission. 

The disbursement of funds is done in a single installment upon approval. 

The scheme is implemented by the Fisheries and Animal Resources Development Department of Odisha. 

The department is responsible for overseeing the entire process from application to disbursement. 

Contact details for the department can be found on their official website. 

The scheme also emphasizes the importance of training and capacity building for beneficiaries. 

Workshops and training sessions are organized to educate farmers about the use of modern equipment. 

These sessions cover best practices in aquaculture and the maintenance of machinery. 

The government has allocated a budget of ₹5 crore for this scheme in the financial year 2021-22. 

This budget is aimed at supporting approximately 5,000 beneficiaries across the state. 

The scheme is expected to significantly enhance fish production in Odisha. 

It aligns with the national goal of increasing fish production to 22 million tonnes by 2022. 

The initiative is also expected to create employment opportunities in the fisheries sector. 

The government aims to empower women by encouraging their participation in aquaculture. 

Self-help groups comprising women are particularly targeted for this assistance. 

The scheme is part of Odisha's vision to become a leading state in aquaculture. 

The state government is committed to sustainable fishing practices. 

This includes promoting environmentally friendly equipment and practices. 

The scheme also aims to reduce the dependency on traditional fishing methods. 

By introducing modern machinery, the government hopes to increase efficiency in fish farming. 

The initiative is expected to improve the quality of fish produced in the state. 

This, in turn, will help meet the growing demand for fish in both domestic and international markets. 

The government has also partnered with various organizations to promote this scheme. 

These partnerships aim to enhance outreach and ensure that the benefits reach the intended beneficiaries. 

Regular monitoring and evaluation of the scheme will be conducted by the department. 

Feedback from beneficiaries will be collected to improve the implementation process. 

The scheme is expected to have a positive impact on the overall economy of Odisha. 

By increasing fish production, it will contribute to food security in the state. 

The government encourages all eligible individuals to take advantage of this scheme. 

Awareness campaigns are being conducted to inform potential beneficiaries about the scheme. 

The scheme is a step towards modernizing the fisheries sector in Odisha. 

It reflects the government's commitment to improving the livelihoods of fish farmers. 

Overall, the "Popularisation Of Fishery Machinery/ Equipments/ Implements For Intensive Aquaculture In Odisha" scheme is a significant initiative. 

It aims to transform the aquaculture landscape in the state through financial assistance and training. 

The government is optimistic about achieving its targets under this scheme. 

This initiative is expected to pave the way for sustainable aquaculture practices in Odisha. 

The focus on modern equipment will help in increasing productivity and profitability for fish farmers. 

The scheme is a vital part of Odisha's fisheries development strategy. 

It is designed to ensure that the benefits of modern aquaculture reach the grassroots level. 

The government is dedicated to supporting the fisheries sector for the betterment of the community. 

This scheme is a clear indication of the government's proactive approach towards fisheries development. 

It is an opportunity for fish farmers to enhance their operations and income. 

The scheme is expected to create a ripple effect in the local economy. 

By promoting aquaculture, the government aims to ensure sustainable livelihoods for many families. 

The initiative is a testament to Odisha's commitment to agricultural and rural development.
